mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, email, password, created_at AS createdAt FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.update: UPDATE buildings SET saved_cnt = saved_cnt + 1 WHERE bd_mgt_sn = #{buildingId}
UPDATE buildings SET saved_cnt = GREATEST(saved_cnt - 1, 0) WHERE bd_mgt_sn = #{buildingId}
mapper.select: SELECT b.bd_mgt_sn AS buildingId, b.bld_nm AS bldNm, b.road_addr AS roadAddr, b.jibun_addr AS jibunAddr, r.total_score AS safetyScore, b.main_purps AS mainPurpsNm, b.grnd_flr AS grndFlr, b.ugrnd_flr AS ugrndFlr, b.use_apr_day AS useAprDay, TRUE AS saved FROM saved s JOIN buildings b ON b.bd_mgt_sn = s.bd_mgt_sn LEFT JOIN building_safety_report r ON r.bd_mgt_sn = s.bd_mgt_sn WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
